datasets.method: Literal source pixel-cell contour placed with one full-map six-parameter EOV affine model from five actual road/rail junction correspondences, then inverse projected to EPSG:4326. Source color barriers and actual pixel cells are retained; Petőfi alone has the separately recorded two-pixel cap under its numeric label. No name-point fitting, per-feature shift, clipping, snapping, repair, smoothing, buffers or frame closures.
uncertainties: Native 945×1364 JPEG; colored boundary bands and manual road picks are several pixels wide. Original map projection, cartographic generalization, boundary survey date and current whole-quarter extent are unestablished. Five-control fit residuals and manually picked road holdouts measure correspondence consistency only, not absolute ground accuracy. A separate full-map similarity model illustrates placement variation without defining a confidence envelope. Municipal 2014 submission, census 2011 statistics and ITS 2016 review periods are distinct. No current-name point is used to fit or correct any coordinate.
Petőfi contains the explicit bounded two-pixel source cap; its alternative is retained separately.
